summary:
Implemented the next Garage staging slice: the staging panel now has a **Final Part Numbers** handoff that can draft from current need-to-buy lines, lets the user enter confirmed part numbers/SKUs, and saves them into the existing syncable Truck Profile `parts_notes` field. No new inventory schema or vehicle facts were added.

Updated verification and memory docs, bumped service worker cache to `ridgeline-console-v298`, and captured the mobile screenshot at `debug-screenshots/audit-v298-final-parts-mobile-garage.png`.

- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1`
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v298-final-parts-profile -SkipScreenshots`

Next slice: real-iPhone review of the staging receipt, final-part-number handoff, quick kits/removal, per-note Need actions, saved-note wording, and iOS share sheet before adding bigger inventory behavior.
